policy: Track material legal instruments and provisions that affect the interpretation, validity, procedure, remedy, or continued currency of a source. Preserve quoted national wording; dependency notes are separate editorial metadata.

dependencies.effect_or_status_note: The CJEU declared Regulation (EU) 2019/1157 invalid for use of an incorrect legal basis, while maintaining its effects until a replacement instrument entered into force (at latest 31 December 2026). Regulation (EU) 2025/1208 was published on 20 June 2025 and entered into force 20 days later, on 10 July 2025 (Article 16). Preserve the original Austrian NAG-DV §5 wording and record this as a separate editorial alert.
dependencies.source_text_policy: Preserve Austrian NAG-DV §5 wording verbatim. Regulation (EU) 2019/1157 was invalidated by CJEU C-61/22 with effects maintained until replacement; Regulation (EU) 2025/1208 entered into force on 10 July 2025. Keep this in separate editorial dependency metadata. The visual Annex E/F sources are accepted as Austrian statutory specimens; their conformity with current card issuance rules remains separately unresolved.

dependencies.note: Native Annex E/F artwork was visually checked and correctly classified as card specimens. The blank models show the bilingual document titles and field labels, but do not demonstrate the standardized Art 10/Art 20 data-field [10] code, a functional ICAO-compliant MRZ, or the security/storage-medium properties. The new Regulation requires the 1030/2002 format as amended by 2017/1954 and implemented by C(2018) 7767 as amended by C(2021) 3726; Article 8 sets transition rules for existing cards. Do not infer that current issued cards are compliant from these blank statutory models; verify the live issued-card specification or national implementation.

A preliminary article map is present below. Every article is classified as mapped, partial, or unresolved; country completion stays blocked until all relevant rows are source-checked or explicitly reasoned not applicable.
